run_main: run the main function to generate Boost.MySQL documentation QKB files from example listings
render_links: render a list of example links using the LINK_TEMPLATE for tutorial or simple examples
write_file: write string contents to a file at a relative path joined with the repo base directory
render_multi_cpp: render multi-file C++ example references by generating unique file IDs from each source path
collect_snippets: collect all snippet file paths from the test integration snippets directory in the repo
